steps.userMessage:
FEN PANTRY | Regional snack box contents and portion imagery

We sell a regional snack box for family cupboards and small gifts. Build six finished shopping images that let buyers see the quantity they receive, the size of an individual portion and everything inside the carton. The existing cream pouches, colored label bands and food shapes are the starting point. Print "FEN PANTRY" and "6 pouches | Net weight 560 g" on the carton lid label and repeat both strings on the vertical gift image and product detail image.

Each box contains two pouches of each of three products: FP01 Oat Rounds, 120 g per pouch with six rounds; FP02 Rye Crackers, 100 g per pouch with ten crackers; and FP03 Apple Rings, 60 g per pouch with twelve rings. The individual pieces weigh 20 g, 10 g and 5 g respectively. All pouches measure 160 × 220 × 40 mm, width × height × filled depth. Their base color is Cream #F3EBDD; the bands are Brown #7A583A for Oat Rounds, Olive #65734B for Rye Crackers and Rust #B45736 for Apple Rings. The Kraft #B99368 carton measures 520 × 260 × 110 mm externally and holds three columns of two flat pouches. Its centered cream lid label measures 180 × 80 mm. Use "Box price: GBP 24.00" on the vertical gift image and product detail image.

Audience: people buying food for their household or as a gift, deciding whether the box's contents, quantity and ingredients suit their purchase.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed box, portion, color and packaging facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists the six deliverables and their proportions, formats and stages. 03-food-records.en.md contains the product names, ingredients, allergens, storage wording and producer details. pack-dimensions.png records the pouch and carton geometry and packing arrangement. information-zones.png records the product detail information fields and reading size. listing-frames.png records the image framing and text zones. oat-rounds.png supplies the existing Oat Rounds pouch, label face and food appearance. rye-crackers.png supplies the existing Rye Crackers pouch, label face and food appearance. apple-rings.png supplies the existing Apple Rings pouch, label face and food appearance. family-table.png supplies the everyday household setting and lighting reference.

Deliverables:
1. One square shopping hero showing the labeled carton and all six sealed pouches against white
2. One range comparison image with three product groups, each showing its two pouches, SKU code, product name, net weight per pouch and piece count per pouch
3. One portion comparison image showing two Oat Rounds totaling 40 g, four Rye Crackers totaling 40 g and six Apple Rings totaling 30 g, each beside its corresponding opened pouch and a shared 100 mm scale bar
4. One overhead unboxing image showing the open carton, its lid label and all six pouches in three columns of two, with the lower pouch in each column visibly exposed
5. One vertical gift image showing the closed labeled carton on a household table, with the box quantity and price wording
6. One product detail image containing the box contents, the three product records, storage wording, producer details and box price

Acceptance:
- The shopping hero and unboxing image show six pouches, two per SKU; the range comparison identifies FP01 Oat Rounds, FP02 Rye Crackers and FP03 Apple Rings with their respective 120 g / six-piece, 100 g / ten-piece and 60 g / twelve-piece pouch contents.
- The portion comparison shows exactly two rounds, four crackers and six rings with totals of 40 g, 40 g and 30 g. Label a round's diameter as 50 mm, a cracker as 60 × 30 mm and a ring's outer diameter as 40 mm; draw the food and 100 mm scale bar at one shared scale.
- The shopping hero, range comparison, portion comparison, unboxing image, vertical gift image and product detail image preserve the attached pouch silhouettes, label positions, Cream #F3EBDD base and three specified band colors. Cartons shown in these images retain the 520 × 260 × 110 mm proportions and centered 180 × 80 mm lid label.
- The shopping hero uses #FFFFFF, with the combined carton-and-pouch group spanning 85–90% of the frame width and wording carried by the physical packaging. The range comparison, portion comparison, unboxing image and vertical gift image place added copy within the lower 30% text zone and 5% edge inset shown in listing-frames.png.
- The shopping hero's carton label, vertical gift image and product detail image carry FEN PANTRY and 6 pouches | Net weight 560 g. The vertical gift image and product detail image also carry Box price: GBP 24.00.
- The product detail image reproduces all three products' names, net weights, ingredients and allergen statements, plus the shared storage and producer records from 03-food-records.en.md. These fields use body text of at least 16 logical units at a 390-unit logical screen width, following information-zones.png.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
